name: Hearth
description: A minimal, private, customizable new tab page. No accounts, no tracking, no bloat.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.google.com https://*.google.com; media-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src https://github-contributions-api.jogruber.de https://leetcode-stats.tashif.codes https://www.google.com
